Write Supabase migrations to extend the InkOS Projects schema per audit. Project at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS.

**Read first:**
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) — Stack A rules, Supabase conventions
- [supabase/migrations/20260420120000_projects.sql] — existing projects table
- [lib/supabase/types.ts] — current generated types
- Other migrations in `supabase/migrations/` — follow naming + style

**Existing `projects` table (20260420120000):**
- id, studio_id, client_id, primary_artist_id, name, placement, style, status (check: active/completed/on_hold/cancelled), total_sessions_planned, total_price_cents, deposit_pool_cents, deposit_applied_cents, moodboard_url, cover_photo_url, started_at, completed_at, timestamps

**Changes:**

### 1. Extend status enum to 7 values
Replace check constraint:
- `planning` (new — pre-deposit)
- `deposit_paid` (new — deposit received, session 1 not yet booked)
- `active` (existing)
- `healing` (new — all sessions complete, awaiting healed photos)
- `completed` (existing)
- `on_hold` (existing)
- `cancelled` (existing)

Migration steps:
- Drop existing check constraint
- Add new check with full 7-value list
- Backfill existing `active` projects: if `completed_at` set → `completed`; else keep `active`
- Default for new rows: `planning`

### 2. Add columns to `projects`
- `size` text NULL — check constraint `small | medium | large | extra_large | full_sleeve | full_back` or NULL
- `color_mode` text NULL — check `color | black_and_grey | both`
- `deposit_apply_rule` text NOT NULL DEFAULT `'last_session'` — check `last_session | split_evenly | manual`
- `secondary_artist_ids` uuid[] NOT NULL DEFAULT `'{}'`
- `reference_notes` text NULL
- `stalled_at` timestamptz NULL — app sets when status=planning and no activity 45+ days; add index

### 3. New table `project_deposit_transactions` (ledger rows)
```sql
project_deposit_transactions (
  id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid(),
  project_id uuid NOT NULL FK projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  type text NOT NULL check (type in ('received','applied','refunded','consumed')),
  amount_cents bigint NOT NULL,
  method text NULL,                   -- 'stripe','cash','card', etc.
  external_id text NULL,              -- payment intent id
  applied_to_session_id uuid NULL FK bookings(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  note text NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  created_by uuid NULL FK profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
```

RLS: studio members CRUD via project.studio_id. Index (project_id, created_at DESC).

AFTER INSERT trigger to maintain invariants:
- type='received' → projects.deposit_pool_cents += amount
- type='applied' → projects.deposit_applied_cents += amount
- type='refunded' → projects.deposit_pool_cents -= amount
- type='consumed' → projects.deposit_pool_cents = 0 (don't subtract; explicit zero)

### 4. New table `project_activity_log`
```sql
project_activity_log (
  id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid(),
  project_id uuid NOT NULL FK projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  actor_id uuid NULL FK profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  event_type text NOT NULL,  -- 'created', 'status_changed', 'deposit_received', 'session_completed', 'photo_uploaded', 'note_added'
  details jsonb NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
```

RLS same as above. Index (project_id, created_at DESC). Append-only (no updated_at).

### 5. Extend `project_references`
- `source` text NOT NULL DEFAULT `'upload'` — check `upload | pinterest | instagram | behance | flash_design`
- `external_url` text NULL
- `flash_design_id` uuid NULL — check if `flash_designs` table exists via grep first. If yes, add FK ON DELETE SET NULL. If no, leave as plain UUID with TODO comment. Report which.

### 6. `clients.date_of_birth`
Check [lib/supabase/types.ts] for `clients.date_of_birth` or `clients.birthday`. If neither, add `date_of_birth date NULL`. If exists, skip. Report which.

### Non-negotiables
- Every table: RLS enabled + studio-scoped policies
- Every FK has an index
- `updated_at` trigger on projects exists — add to new tables if they have update logic; log tables are append-only so no updated_at needed
- No drops of existing data, no type changes that lose data
- Filename: `20260422HHMMSS_<slug>.sql` using today's date (2026-04-22) + distinct time per file

### Deliverables
1. Migration files under `supabase/migrations/`
2. Run `pnpm db:types` after local apply to regenerate types
3. Run `pnpm typecheck` — no breaks
4. Report: migrations written, rows backfilled, RLS confirmed on new tables, flash_designs FK added or skipped, clients.date_of_birth added or existing

Run migrations locally (`supabase db reset` or migration up) before completing. If local DB unavailable, lint SQL and report what would happen.

395	RETURNS TRIGGER
396	LANGUAGE plpgsql
397	AS $$
398	BEGIN
399	  -- Only fire when project_id is newly set and session_number is still null
400	  IF NEW.project_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.session_number IS NULL THEN
401	    SELECT COALESCE(MAX(session_number), 0) + 1
402	    INTO NEW.session_number
403	    FROM bookings
404	    WHERE project_id = NEW.project_id
405	      AND id != NEW.id;  -- exclude self on UPDATE
406	  END IF;
407	  RETURN NEW;
408	END;
409	$$;

429	  WHERE id = p_project_id;
430	$$;

-- ============================================================
-- Migration: 20260422100200_project_deposit_transactions
-- Purpose : Ledger table for project deposit movements
--           Trigger maintains projects.deposit_pool_cents /
--           deposit_applied_cents after every INSERT.
-- Tables  : project_deposit_transactions
-- Rollback:
--   DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_project_deposit_sync ON project_deposit_transactions;
--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS sync_project_deposit_on_transaction();
--   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS project_deposit_transactions;
-- ============================================================

-- ============================================================
-- 1. Table
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_deposit_transactions (
  id                     uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  project_id             uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)  ON DELETE CASCADE,
  type                   text        NOT NULL
                           CHECK (type IN ('received', 'applied', 'refunded', 'consumed')),
  amount_cents           bigint      NOT NULL,
  method                 text        NULL,         -- PII:L2 — 'stripe','cash','card', etc.
  external_id            text        NULL,         -- payment intent id / external reference
  applied_to_session_id  uuid        NULL REFERENCES bookings(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  note                   text        NULL,
  created_at             timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  created_by             uuid        NULL REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);

COMMENT ON TABLE project_deposit_transactions IS
  'Immutable ledger of deposit movements for a project. Append-only.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN project_deposit_transactions.type IS
  'received=deposit in, applied=credited to session, refunded=returned to client, consumed=zeroed out';
COMMENT ON COLUMN project_deposit_transactions.external_id IS
  'Payment intent ID, Dodo Payments reference, or other external identifier';

-- ── Indexes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- Primary query: ledger for a project, newest first
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pdt_project_created
  ON project_deposit_transactions (project_id, created_at DESC);

-- FK index: session link
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pdt_applied_to_session
  ON project_deposit_transactions (applied_to_session_id)
  WHERE applied_to_session_id IS NOT NULL;

-- FK index: creator
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pdt_created_by
  ON project_deposit_transactions (created_by)
  WHERE created_by IS NOT NULL;

-- ============================================================
-- 2. Trigger: maintain projects deposit counters after INSERT
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sync_project_deposit_on_transaction()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.type = 'received' THEN
    -- Money came in — grow the pool
    UPDATE projects
    SET deposit_pool_cents = deposit_pool_cents + NEW.amount_cents
    WHERE id = NEW.project_id;

  ELSIF NEW.type = 'applied' THEN
    -- Deposit allocated to a session — grow the applied counter
    UPDATE projects
    SET deposit_applied_cents = deposit_applied_cents + NEW.amount_cents
    WHERE id = NEW.project_id;

  ELSIF NEW.type = 'refunded' THEN
    -- Money returned to client — shrink the pool
    UPDATE projects
    SET deposit_pool_cents = GREATEST(deposit_pool_cents - NEW.amount_cents, 0)
    WHERE id = NEW.project_id;

  ELSIF NEW.type = 'consumed' THEN
    -- Explicit zero-out (e.g. writeoff). Pool goes to 0, applied stays.
    UPDATE projects
    SET deposit_pool_cents = 0
    WHERE id = NEW.project_id;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_project_deposit_sync ON project_deposit_transactions;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_project_deposit_sync
  AFTER INSERT ON project_deposit_transactions
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_project_deposit_on_transaction();

-- ============================================================
-- 3. RLS
-- ============================================================

ALTER TABLE project_deposit_transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- SELECT: any active studio member who can read the parent project's studio
CREATE POLICY "pdt_select"
  ON project_deposit_transactions
  FOR SELECT
  USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM projects p
      JOIN studio_members sm ON sm.studio_id = p.studio_id
      WHERE p.id            = project_deposit_transactions.project_id
        AND sm.user_id      = auth.uid()
        AND sm.deactivated_at IS NULL
    )
  );

-- INSERT: owner / admin / receptionist (artists don't write deposit ledger rows)
CREATE POLICY "pdt_insert"
  ON project_deposit_transactions
  FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM projects p
      JOIN studio_members sm ON sm.studio_id = p.studio_id
      WHERE p.id            = project_deposit_transactions.project_id
        AND sm.user_id      = auth.uid()
        AND sm.deactivated_at IS NULL
        AND sm.role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'receptionist')
    )
  );

-- UPDATE: explicitly denied — ledger rows are immutable
CREATE POLICY "pdt_no_update"
  ON project_deposit_transactions
  FOR UPDATE
  USING (false);

-- DELETE: explicitly denied — ledger rows are immutable
CREATE POLICY "pdt_no_delete"
  ON project_deposit_transactions
  FOR DELETE
  USING (false);

-- UPDATE: denied — append-only

  FOR UPDATE
  USING (false);

  ON project_activity_log
